name: Base Rate Fallacy
definition: Relevant population prevalence is neglected in favor of case-specific information.
boundary: Require an available relevant base rate being neglected; overlap with representativeness is possible.

source_variants.name: Base Rate Fallacy (Taban oran yanılgısı)
source_variants.definition: Putting concrete, striking information ahead of the relevant general statistics.
source_variants.coverage_reason: No named mechanism, required state or observation model is implemented in the original Mesa sample.
